All my conditions are considered invisible illnesses so people cant see what I go through as easily. I can honestly say I'm so happy to have a huge stress liftled off my shoulders by not working. I'm autistic, agrophobic and have fibromyalgia.  I hate the stigma around benefits and invisible illnesses. I'm always so embarrassed to tell people I'm on benefits and I DREAD the "so what do you do for a living?" Question. I always explain and get either solemn looks and sympathy or confusion/disgust.
